doc.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Theater work in London after the trio
summary: After the trio she did theater in London, including Kennedy's Children and Three Penny Opera with Vanessa Redgrave.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Wow. Well post Lambert, Hendricks & Ross, you did some more theater?

I did some wonderful theater in London. I did “Kennedy’s Children” which is a wonderful play. I did Jenny, the betrayer in “Three Penny Opera” with Vanessa Redgrave. I’ve done all kinds. You know, if I couldn’t work anymore and couldn’t sing anymore, I could always go into the theater and be a wonderful dresser, you know, dress people for their parts. Because I know how to do all that, and stage managing. I’ve had a really good grounding in that. And one is an extension of the other. You know, acting is singing, singing is acting.
